changes: Removed xutils cache-busting query from module import.
CFT GRT clamp derivatives now match the supplied third_party/Xfoil/src/xblsys.f (newer than the nested Vibefoil Fortran copy).
XOPER returns Newton iteration history, supports optional progress/log callbacks and labels RMSBL as an update norm. Removed nonfinite GAM fallback.
XBL initialization logging is optional via the context.

Documented original BLDIF turbulent lag Jacobian omission (UQ_RTA), preserving its numerical behavior by default. Optional EXACT_BL_JACOBIAN restores its Reynolds-thickness terms and the explicit US contribution to the freestream-Re partial without changing residual equations.

In exact-Jacobian mode, correct the original DILW shape-derivative sign. The original dissipation value and default native partials are unchanged; compiled native value differences and retained wake blocks verify the correction.

Exact-Jacobian mode differentiates the active BLVAR Hk lower limit and the saturated BLDIF upwind exponent. Native values/default derivatives are unchanged; analytic branches replace the coupled extreme-upwind numerical fallback.

Optional TRANSITION_TOLERANCE resolves the existing TRCHEK2 amplification root more tightly and rejects unresolved requested roots. The default retains the native 5e-5 stopping tolerance. Automatic quad coupling requests 1e-12 to prevent stopping-iteration jumps in local numerical derivatives. A native copy with only DAEPS changed and diagnostic tracing verifies the same equations at the tighter accuracy.
